panels.figure_caption: Histopathological section of the skin (H&E, ×10). in_text_mentions: Skin biopsies were performed from the atrophic patches, which showed a microscopic picture of normal epidermis, markedly reduced dermal thickness, loosely arranged collagen bundles, and adipose tissue replacement in the papillary dermis. Adipocytes could be seen extending to the undersurface of the epidermis (Figure 2).
